solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Old relation requires a lawyer in Spanish city

parts.note: a gran is a grandmother, an older relative
DA is a district attorney, an American lawyer

explanation.surface: A family member needs legal help while staying in a city in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Granada is a city in Andalusia, home of the Alhambra palace.

clue.text: Visit live drama at front or hit the hay?

parts.note: to go to a place is to visit it
to be is to exist, to live

indicators.note: the front of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Do we see a show tonight or just get an early night?
explanation.definitionFit: Hitting the hay is an informal idiom for retiring to sleep.

clue.text: A fool and son willing to try a hopeless venture

parts.note: a mug is a gullible fool
S is the abbreviation for son in family trees
someone game is up for anything

explanation.surface: A foolish father and his eager son take on a doomed scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A mug's game is an idiom for an activity unlikely to bring any reward.

clue.text: A jerk with tip of toe stuck in loft

indicators.note: the letter is lodged inside the other pieces

parts.note: a tic is an involuntary jerk

indicators.note: the tip of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone jerks and stubs a toe up in the loft.
explanation.definitionFit: An attic is the room just under a roof, also called a loft.

clue.text: Everyone needs to take on British rugby team

indicators.note: taking on means admitting someone, so one piece is taken into the others

parts.note: everyone means all
lacks means needs or is without

explanation.surface: The whole country must face the British rugby side.
explanation.walkthrough: The All Blacks are New Zealand's national rugby union team, so 'British' is a red herring for the team itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The All Blacks, named for their black kit, are New Zealand's national rugby union side.

clue.text: Backsliding US agent liberal had let down

indicators.note: sliding back tells us the agent's word is read from end to start

parts.note: a Fed is an FBI agent in American slang
had a meal means ate

explanation.surface: A disgraced American agent has let a liberal colleague down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'US agent' is slang: a Fed is a federal agent, typically of the FBI.
explanation.definitionFit: To let down a tyre or balloon is to release its air, which is what deflating means.

clue.text: An idiot as well as a sucker?

definitions.meaning: the rubber teat a baby sucks, called a pacifier in America

explanation.surface: Is a fool also someone easily conned?
explanation.walkthrough: 'sucker' looks like a gullible person but is the baby's teat.
explanation.definitionFit: A fool is a dummy, and so is a baby's pacifier.

clue.text: Awfully fiery arts student just started at college

indicators.note: awfully suggests something done badly, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A new art student is fiercely passionate.
explanation.definitionFit: A first-year is a student in the opening year of a course.

clue.text: A brew taken around bow of ship away from port?

indicators.note: the drink is wrapped around the letter

parts.note: a brew is a pot or cup of tea

indicators.note: the bow is the front of a ship, so the first letter

explanation.surface: A cup of tea is passed round the front of a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Being at sea means out on the water, not in harbour.

clue.text: EU leader's proposal creating strong feeling

indicators.note: a word's leader is its first letter

parts.note: a motion is a proposal put to a meeting

explanation.surface: A European Union chief's motion arouses passions.
explanation.definitionFit: An emotion is a strong feeling such as joy or anger.

clue.text: Deliberately provoke Greek character with books

parts.note: tau is the nineteenth letter of the Greek alphabet
NT is the New Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A Greek person with books needles someone on purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: To taunt is to goad or jeer at someone so as to get a reaction.

clue.text: Meat and game that's accompanied by old wine

parts.note: lamb is a kind of meat
RU is rugby union
that's contracts to that is, and the 's supplies the letter
C is short for Latin cum, meaning with, as in medical prescriptions

explanation.surface: A meal of lamb and game is served with a glass of something old.
explanation.walkthrough: C for 'accompanied by' comes from cum (Latin for with), the abbreviation used on prescriptions.
explanation.definitionFit: Lambrusco is a lightly sparkling red Italian wine from Emilia-Romagna.

clue.text: Put simply, I'll say ABC in the wrong order

indicators.note: letters out of their proper order are a jumble to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A child explains the alphabet simply but jumbles the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Basically is used to introduce a plain summary, just as 'put simply' does.

clue.text: Woman seen in paintings around cold island

indicators.note: turned around, the word for paintings is read backwards

parts.note: paintings collectively are art
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: A woman appears in pictures of a chilly island.
explanation.definitionFit: Traci is a female given name, so any woman bearing it fits.

clue.text: Male sheep in Dhaka's outskirts creates excitement

indicators.note: the sheep is placed within the outer letters
the outskirts of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: A ram on the edge of Bangladesh's capital causes a commotion.
explanation.definitionFit: Drama can mean exciting or turbulent events, as in a day full of drama.

clue.text: Drink shot on camera? I must be involved in that!

indicators.note: the letter I is to be put inside the rearranged letters
shot means broken or wrecked, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone filmed asks whether they should appear in the shot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' looks like filming but is the anagram signal; 'involved in' puts I into the rearranged ON CAMERA.
explanation.definitionFit: An Americano is espresso diluted with hot water, a coffee drink.

clue.text: One might change colour of home and clean up

indicators.note: letters that are mixed up or messed up are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone tidies the house and finds a different colour scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clean up' looks like a phrasal verb, but 'up' alone signals the anagram of HOME and CLEAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A chameleon is a lizard famous for shifting its skin colour.

clue.text: One who attacks Alsatians must change

indicators.note: changing the letters means putting them in a new order

explanation.surface: Guard dogs that attack people must be retrained.
explanation.definitionFit: An assailant is a person who assaults someone.

clue.text: Fancy beer served up by contrary old boy to judge

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: ale is a type of beer

indicators.note: contrary means the other way round, so read backwards

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
to rate is to assess or judge

explanation.surface: A former pupil serves fancy beer and then judges it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served up' turns ALE to ELA; 'contrary' turns OB to BO.
explanation.definitionFit: Fancy as an adjective means ornate or intricate, which is what elaborate means.

clue.text: Football squad near Kent having small snack

parts.note: a football team has eleven players
Kent is a county in South-East England, SE
S is the abbreviation for small, as in clothing sizes

explanation.surface: A football team near Kent has a little snack.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent is a county in the south-east of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevenses is the British mid-morning snack, taken around eleven o'clock.

clue.text: Went out to drink drop of Cognac in a buzzy mood

indicators.note: drinking takes something in, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: exited means left or went out

indicators.note: a drop of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone left the bar after a sip of brandy, feeling merry.
explanation.definitionFit: Being excited means feeling thrilled and lively, a buzz of eagerness.

clue.text: Soldiers first to attack large mountain kingdom

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

indicators.note: first to means the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: M is an abbreviation for mountain on maps

explanation.surface: Troops are first to storm a big mountain kingdom.
explanation.definitionFit: A realm is a domain ruled by a monarch, the same thing as a kingdom.

clue.text: Male milliners will not start to have affairs

indicators.note: dropping the start removes the opening letter

parts.note: milliners make hats, so they are hatters

explanation.surface: Male hat-makers are reluctant to begin romantic flings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affairs' looks romantic but means business or concerns.
explanation.definitionFit: Affairs and matters both mean concerns or business, as in personal affairs.

clue.text: Island put a limit on rebellious island leaders

parts.note: to cap something is to set a ceiling on it

indicators.note: the leaders of words are their first letters

explanation.surface: An island state restricts the rebel leaders of another island.
explanation.definitionFit: Capri is an island in the Bay of Naples, off southern Italy.

clue.text: Type of music written by secretary for American Dad

parts.note: pop is a genre of music
a PA is a personal assistant, a secretary

explanation.surface: A pop song is composed by an assistant for a US father.
explanation.definitionFit: Poppa is an informal American word for a father.

clue.text: Criminal lied about being helped to get free?

indicators.note: criminal suggests something crooked, so the letters are bent out of order

explanation.surface: A crook lied about being sprung from custody with help.
explanation.definitionFit: To be bailed out is to be rescued, whether released on bail or rescued from financial trouble.

clue.text: Head of shower with touch of blue on top of it

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece sits above the other
a touch of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a shower is a spell of rain

explanation.surface: A showerhead has a hint of blue on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head of shower' looks like one phrase; 'Head' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Head is a familiar word for the brain, as in 'use your head'.

clue.text: Paper with French article about English barman

indicators.note: turned about means read backwards

parts.note: a rag is a disparaging word for a newspaper
le is the French word for the

explanation.surface: A newspaper and French piece about an English bartender.
explanation.walkthrough: 'barman' is not a bartender but a man of musical bars: a composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Edward Elgar was an English composer, and composers write music in bars.

clue.text: Kitty brought over fruit and a big cheese

indicators.note: brought over suggests a word flipped right round, read backwards

parts.note: a kitty is a pot of shared money
a banana is a fruit

explanation.surface: A cat brings over some fruit and a large wheel of cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought over' turns POT into TOP; 'Kitty' is money, not a cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A big cheese and a top banana are both slang for the most important person.

clue.text: Elegance of movement in good competition

parts.note: a race is a competition

explanation.surface: A runner moves elegantly in a fine contest.
explanation.definitionFit: Grace is smooth, poised beauty in the way someone moves.

clue.text: Fire-breathing beast eats old cavalryman

indicators.note: eating takes something inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a dragon is the fire-breathing beast of legend

explanation.surface: A dragon devours an elderly mounted soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A dragoon was a mounted infantry soldier, later a kind of cavalry trooper.

clue.text: Tank tops

parts.note: not sleeveless jumpers but the revolving gun housings on top of armoured tanks

explanation.surface: Sleeveless knitted vests.
explanation.walkthrough: A tank top is a sleeveless knitted top; read literally, the tops of military tanks are their gun housings.
explanation.definitionFit: On an armoured tank the rotating armoured gun mount sits on top of the hull.
